v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Stabunt iusti in magna constántia advérsus eos qui se angustiavérunt et qui abstulérunt labóres eórum.
text.en: Then shall the just stand with great constancy against those that have afflicted them, and taken away their labours.

v.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord, alleluia.

r.en: Is the death of his saints, alleluia.

text.la: Fíliæ Ierúsalem, * veníte et vidéte Mártyres cum corónis, quibus coronávit eos Dóminus in die solemnitátis et lætítiæ, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Daughters of Jerusalem, * come and see the crowned martyrs, the Lord crowned them in his solemnity and delight, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Semper nos, Dómine, Mártyrum tuórum Nérei, Achíllei, Domitíllæ atque Pancrátii fóveat, quǽsumus, beáta solémnitas: et tuo dignos reddat obséquio.
text.en: May the holy feast of thy Martyrs, Nereus, Achilleus, Domitilla and Pancras, ever comfort us, we beseech thee, O Lord, and make us worthy to serve thee.

office.title: Ss. Nerei, Achillei et Domitillæ Virg. atque Pancratii Martyrum
